title: Escalators and elevators: the enemy?
content: In my mall dreams and often in my “I never graduated college and have just been taking classes for ten years” dreams… escalators are either too steep, lead to a cliff, and lately, too fast to the point where I have to hold on for dear life. Elevators often throw me around as they zigzag in a way that makes no sense and again I’m holding on for dear life. Anyone else?
